chunks: The day you see it, every suckling female will forget her suckling, and every pregnant female will discharge her burden. You will see men drunk, yet it will not be intoxication. The torment of God will be severe.

key_terms.تَذْهَلُ: to be distracted or neglectful due to awe

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people are described as 'drunk' on the Day of Judgment in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Hajj highlights the total suspension of natural human instincts during the Hour, illustrating how the magnitude of divine reckoning overrides biological imperatives. The 'drunkenness' is interpreted as a state of cognitive paralysis induced by the sheer intensity of Allah's wrath, serving as a profound reminder of the transient nature of worldly concerns compared to the eternal reality of the Hereafter.
